    int best = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
        int rem = T;
        int cnt = 0;
        for (size_t j = i; j < a.size(); ++j) {
            if (j == i) {
                cnt = 1;

                rem -= gap;

            }

    return best;
}
